channels.description: Third-party app stores where Picqer is listed.

"Picqer | Pick & ship faster" listing (apps.shopify.com/picqer) with a 14-day free trial. It imports Shopify orders, pushes shipping status and tracking codes back and updates Shopify stock in real time. Limits: products need a unique SKU, and only one Shopify location is managed.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Shopify app listing that installs the Picqer-built Shopify connector.

usedInProducts.description: Shopify merchants install Picqer for Online Stores from the Shopify App Store.
Fulfilment clients on Shopify connect their store to a Picqer-run 3PL.
